newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merck estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merck estimates raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it raised its estimate for Merck & Co Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $3.80 from $3.70 and its estimate for fiscal 1998 to $4.40 from $4.20 a share.

-- Gruntal said Merck, rated outperform, reported surprisingly better-than-expected fourth-quarter and year-end results, beating Gruntal's and Wall Street's consensus estimates. Merck yesterday said net income in the fourth quarter reached $0.87 a share versus $0.70 in 1995.
-- Merck's superior sales growth was powered by newly launched products with high margins, Gruntal said.
-- Merck is a pharmaceutical development company.
-- Its shares were trading up 3/4 Wednesday at 87-3/4.
